parts.title: Baking Day
parts.text: Sam, Lucia, and Amir went into the bakery kitchen. Today they would make muffins. Lucia turned on the **oven**. Amir began to **mash** some ripe bananas in a bowl. “They are so soft!” he said.

parts.title: Mixing
parts.text: Sam helped **pour** milk into the bowl. Lucia used a big spoon to **stir**. The batter was **sticky** and clung to the spoon. Amir wanted to **taste** it. “Not yet!” said Lucia. Sam gave a lemon a light **squeeze**, and a little juice dripped in.

parts.title: Done!
parts.text: The muffins came out **fluffy** and warm. The tops were **crispy** and gold. A **crumb** fell on the table. Lucia spread **frosting** on top. Everyone said the muffins were **delicious**.

parts.title: Sharing
parts.text: The friends put the muffins on a plate and shared them with the neighbors. Baking was fun, and sharing made it better.
